item.title: Gold retreats from weekly top as USD rebounds slightly following the post-FOMC slump
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) retreats following a modest Asian session uptick to the $4,247 area, or a fresh weekly high, and for now, seems to have snapped a two-day winning streak.

item.title: Japanese Yen trims intraday gains vs rebounding USD; hawkish BoJ bets favor bulls
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) surrenders a major part of its Asian session gains against a broadly rebounding US Dollar (USD), though any meaningful downside seems elusive.

item.title: GBP/USD softens as traders eye BoE rate cut next week
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades in negative territory near 1.3365 during the early European trading hours on Thursday, pressured by the rebound in the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: USD/INR gains sharply amid uncertainty surrounding US-India trade talks
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) faces intense selling pressure against the US Dollar (USD) at open on Thursday. The USD/INR pair jumps to near 90.40 as the Indian Rupee slumps amid uncertainty surrounding trade talks between the United States (US) and India.

item.title: FOMC lowers rates for third straight meeting
item.description: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) lowered the federal funds rate by 25 basis points for the third straight meeting on Wednesday.

item.title: AUD/JPY tumbles to near 103.50 on mixed Australian employment data
item.description: AUD/JPY slumps to around 103.50 during the early European session on Thursday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) softens against the Japanese Yen (JPY) following the release of mixed Australian employment data.
